inline_text:
The 2026-08-18 notes attributed Pavan Sudheendra's cross-boundary observability framework request to the Identity and Trust WG. Pavan chairs the Observability and Traceability WG and authored that framework (aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability#25), so this fixes the attribution in the notes and the README summary row.

Surfaced during TC review of the August report: https://github.com/aaif/wg-security-and-privacy/pull/22#discussion_r4071307156
